sahneler.metin: Hurricane Katrina knocked dozens of spans off a bridge near New Orleans.
Within hours, the interstate link across Lake Pontchartrain was cut.
Storm surge raised the water up to the bridge deck.
The spans were held mostly by their own weight.
They were lifted and dropped off their piers.
Air trapped under the deck added buoyancy.
The replacement bridge was built much higher.

aciklama:
I-10 Twin Span had dozens of spans knocked off their piers. The cause: surge raising water to the deck while waves lifted spans that were not anchored against uplift.
